name: GUI Followers
summary: Client-side HUD list of tamed, non-sitting pets near you, showing each one's health percentage and distance in blocks. Helps you avoid leaving a wolf behind.
qol: Defaults: header 'Followers:', health % and distance shown, list at top left, 50 block scan radius, refresh every 2 seconds; position, colors and formats configurable
getting_started: Tame a pet and keep it standing; the list appears automatically.
